parent_objective: materialize artifact-only localization slices from M2413 measured outcome rows
blocked_by: family membership is overlapping and must remain diagnostic
direct repair execution is not admissible before localization
supersedes: direct repair from M2413 global outcome

public_gates: M2415 must read only M2413 artifacts and not rerun measured validation
M2415 must write localization rows and summary under its run dir
M2415 must keep family, profile, and controller axes diagnostic-only
M2415 must classify offtrack, collision, max-step, speed-too-low, and R4 mitigation slices
M2415 must not execute repair, train, replay, PPO, rank, select winner, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not rank selected checkpoints or profiles
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the complete M2413 measured artifact into bounded localization slices for next-route decisions
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: artifact-only localization; no rerun, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2413 source rows are missing or incomplete
stop if localization requires rerun or active config overwrite
stop if family/profile slices are converted into ranking
stop if the output claims repair success or current-sim verdict
fallback_plan: if localization support is too broad, route to target consolidation
if localization duplicates M2399/M2401 without new source-linked value, route to branch synthesis
if metadata gaps appear, route to result audit instead of repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: synthesize after at most 10 milestones in this branch or immediately if localization adds no decision value

admission_evidence: M2413 writes primary episode rows and family-membership rows
allowed_updates: M2415 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by M2415
next_stage_criteria: a bounded next route is selected or the branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2415 localizes measured outcomes but does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2415; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Outcome localization is engineering/task-quality evidence only until a later history-intervention branch is run.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, effective-candidate ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: re-analyzes a new source-linked measured panel at reset-target and family-membership level
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can identify actionable blocker slices but cannot establish paper/current-sim verdict
must_synthesize_if: localization is too broad for a bounded next decision
another localization-only milestone is proposed without consolidation or synthesis
five milestones pass without measured evidence or synthesis

hypothesis: Artifact-only localization of M2413 rows will produce bounded diagnostic slices for offtrack/collision/R4 outcome blockers without rerun, repair, ranking, or verdict claims.
failure_criteria: M2415 ranks candidate families, profiles, or selected checkpoints
M2415 makes measured driver success, current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID claims
decision_rule: M2415 passes if it materializes bounded artifact-only localization slices from M2413 rows while preserving diagnostic-only family/profile/controller boundaries and avoiding rerun, repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
